mechanism: Startup-owned compact preswizzled FP8 input quads for all 144 QKV/Z/Q/K/V roles; exact existing four-chain sidecar consumer. Keep NVFP4 Gate/Up; remove FP8 O and NVFP4 Down scale6/consumer sidecars for reserve. O and Down use exact canonical consumers.
scope: One fixed composition plus at most one correctness repair; T1 exact byte/consumer gate, P65 full transactions, P8192 prefixes, then immediate P65/8K/40K d2/d3 API with existing negative direction stop. No local timing or layout/grid scan.
source_rationale: Canonical FP8 input projection executes four scalar 32-bit weight loads and four word swizzles per K iteration; native quad executes one aligned uint4 and no per-word swizzle. Unique weight bytes do not decrease; no DRAM/stall counter claim.
budget: Matched 40K canonical-input verifier FP8 costs 5.453514208 GPU seconds. That maximum alone cannot close full gap. Resource substitution and whole API select this bounded architecture prerequisite.
rejected_before_implementation: Full input BF16 expansion needs 10401873920 bytes and doubles steady-state input-weight bytes; not selected on this budget.
rollback: Restore task-owned runtime to ae6542f; remove private owner/packer/build selector; preserve frozen evidence.

reference_translation.principle: Proven startup producer / native consumer weight permutation; fixed SM87 SIMT reduction instead of importing Marlin MMA arithmetic. Existing output-quad packing supplies exact lookup swizzle. No imported source. FlashInfer/FLA/Mamba state paths remain retained v7.
